task.title: Apply the attached system UI to the Administration pages
task.objective: Replace the Users, Roles, Permissions, Audit Log, and Licensing renderer presentation with the attached SpecterStudio system design while preserving their real administration, authorization, audit, and offline-license behavior.

architecture: Change only renderer composition and token CSS; preserve routes, app shell, preload APIs, main-process authorization, audit storage, and license enforcement.
Reuse the existing Hologram tokens, shared Administration components, semantic tables, page-chrome actions, dialogs, and responsive table overflow treatment.
Do not copy reference demo records, simulated account state, or fake actions into product UI.
accessibility: Preserve semantic headings, table markup, labels, accessible action names, focus restoration, visible focus styles, responsive containment, and reduced-motion behavior.
offline: Do not add dependencies, remote assets, fonts, scripts, or runtime network access.

acceptance.description: Users, Roles, Permissions, Audit Log, and Licensing use the attached system UI hierarchy: compact KPI surfaces, prominent titled content panels, icon-led identity/status treatments, and token-driven responsive spacing.

Existing user, role, permissions, audit, and licensing controls retain their handlers, authorization paths, reauthentication behavior, and IPC/preload contracts; no enabled placeholder control is introduced.
The task records accurate AI-memory and roadmap evidence before terminal closeout.
